scope: Private supplied-byte NTFS3.0/3.1 INDX protected block observation, disjoint-buffer restoration and entry-cursor initialization. Original NTFS namespace/content, source-bound acquisition, bitmap/allocation/collation and all original platforms remain required later work. No new opener, native I/O, writer or public command.
ownership: index_block.c owns INDX fields and checked entry-span initialization under portable/ntfs. Share the demonstrated FILE/INDX tail comparison, disjoint-span check and tail replacement in fixup.c with a private fixup.h; preserve existing FILE API and observable results. Existing index.c owns entry decoding. Keep the existing disked_ntfs library and private ntfs.h; no new library or generic record framework.
controls: Private C callers provide stable valid original views, disjoint control/output objects and writable separate destination storage. Null required pointers, null nonempty spans or unsupported major/minor return DE_INVALID unchanged. Explicit expected block bytes must be a power of two from512 through49152 and expected VBN must be nonnegative(high bit clear); invalid controls or raw bytes above49152 return DE_BOUNDS unchanged. Entry limit1..4096 is checked before destination writes. These are parser inputs, not proof of boot geometry or source identity.
header: Read all40 fixed bytes before exposing fields: INDX signature, USA offset/count at4/6, opaque LSN at8, full VBN at16, first/used/allocated at24/28/32 and flag byte36. Preserve reserved bytes without interpretation. Supplied size must exactly equal expected size; VBN must exactly match the expected full64-bit value. Flags allow only bit0(children). First>=16, first8-aligned, used>=first+16, used<=allocated<=raw.size-24; compare before narrowing. Do not scan entries or infer source authority.
fixups: USA starts at an even offset>=40, ends no later than first stride tail at510, fits supplied bytes and ends no later than absolute first entry24+first. Count must equal raw.size/512+1 for the exact supported size. Compare every512-byte stride tail against the original USA sequence before any restoration; report mismatch count. No zero/nonzero policy for the sequence itself. fixups_valid depends on length/count/array/tails only; envelope_valid requires every header/signature/VBN/flag check as well. LSN remains opaque.
restoration: Observe malformed supplied data with DE_OK plus issue bits. Restore/begin require a completely valid envelope, else DE_INVALID with all destinations/control outputs unchanged. A short writable destination returns DE_BUFFER unchanged. Any overlap between the original and the written raw-size prefix returns DE_INVALID unchanged, including equal/forward/backward spans; excess output capacity is not written. Validate every tail before copying, then replace only the final two bytes of each stride using the original USA entries. Original bytes stay unchanged.
cursor: Begin validates controls, restores the separate buffer and initializes the existing index cursor from restored bytes at24+first for used-first bytes, with original profile, explicit limit and child flag. It never creates a cursor over protected bytes. Existing exact terminal, child/key/reference, quota, offset and repeated DE_EMPTY semantics remain. Failure leaves the block result/cursor and destination unchanged. The block result borrows original bytes, the cursor borrows destination bytes; both lifetimes are caller-owned.
validation: Define independent byte recipes and expected fields/issues before evaluation. Cover every fixed-header truncation and byte truncation through two strides, all supported sizes/profiles, per-stride torn tails, last legal/illegal USA offsets and overlap with entry area, count/first/used/allocation/flags/signature/VBN, nonzero high VBN words, zero sequence and opaque reserved data. Restore guard/sentinel/alias/short-buffer and invalid-control tests must prove no write on failure. Cross-stride entry/key/child bytes must decode only after restoration. Preserve full existing FILE corpus and run a clean complete native campaign because the actual FILE fixup implementation is shared, strict C90/C header, standalone C++ headers, imports, full tooling, input/context/manifest/source checks. Retain failures accurately.
